description: This file contains functions and classes for generating status messages, help messages, and command/tool listings for an AI agent framework. It includes logic for formatting usage, session info, model details, and command menus, integrating various agent and session configurations.

methods.name: normalizeAuthMode
methods.description: Normalizes a string value into a predefined set of authentication modes ('api-key', 'oauth', 'token', 'aws-sdk', 'mixed', 'unknown').

methods.name: resolveConfiguredTextVerbosity
methods.description: Determines the verbosity level ('low', 'medium', 'high') based on provider and model configuration.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeLabel
methods.description: Generates a string label indicating the runtime environment (direct, docker, unknown) based on session and sandbox status.

methods.name: formatTokens
methods.description: Formats token counts and context tokens into a string representation.

methods.name: formatContextUsageShort
methods.description: Provides a short string summarizing context token usage.

methods.name: formatQueueDetails
methods.description: Creates a string describing queue status details such as depth, debounce, cap, and drop policy.

methods.name: readUsageFromSessionLog
methods.description: Reads recent usage data from session log files, extracting token counts and models.

methods.name: formatUsagePair
methods.description: Formats input/output token counts into a display string.

methods.name: formatCacheLine
methods.description: Creates a string summarizing cache hit/miss statistics.

methods.name: formatMediaUnderstandingLine
methods.description: Generates a string describing media understanding decisions.

methods.name: formatVoiceModeLine
methods.description: Creates a string describing voice mode snapshot settings.

methods.name: buildStatusMessage
methods.description: Constructs a detailed status message string for an agent session, including model, usage, context, and environment info.

methods.name: groupCommandsByCategory
methods.description: Groups command definitions into categories for display.

methods.name: buildHelpMessage
methods.description: Generates a help message listing available commands and options.

methods.name: sortToolsMessageItems
methods.description: Sorts tool items alphabetically by name.

methods.name: formatCompactToolEntry
methods.description: Formats a tool item into a compact string for display.

methods.name: formatVerboseToolDescription
methods.description: Provides a verbose description of a tool.

methods.name: buildToolsMessage
methods.description: Creates a message listing available tools, optionally verbose.

methods.name: formatCommandEntry
methods.description: Formats a command definition into a display string with aliases and scope.

methods.name: buildCommandItems
methods.description: Builds a list of command items grouped by category, including plugin commands.

methods.name: formatCommandList
methods.description: Formats a list of command items into a string with category headers.

methods.name: buildCommandsMessage
methods.description: Builds a full command list message, defaulting to first page.

methods.name: buildCommandsMessagePaginated
methods.description: Builds a paginated command list message with navigation info.
